mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate above 6% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and aggregate demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.2 million units signals a strengthening demand for housing and related sectors, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in federal funds rate and decline in consumer price index signals a tightening monetary cycle that reduces inflation expectations and increases real interest rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp and CPIAUCSL declines > 0.2pp in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
